goals: Execute assigned ticket work (troubleshoot/install/recovery) stop-by-stop with full on-site context
Handle field exceptions cleanly (component unavailable, vehicle unavailable, 409 conflict) without losing SLA fairness or component tracking
Trust the closure/verification feedback loop without phoning the Zonal Manager
scopeNote: Module boundary as given (admin /tickets,/install,/readiness/* + mobile ticket screens) fuses two personas: Ravi executes tickets on mobile all day (chosen here); Zonal Manager separately OWNS the web-side oversight surfaces in this same boundary - ticket list+drawer triage, WAITING_COMPONENT/7-day escalation, repeat-failure/ESCALATED flags, Verification Review page (fraud flags, PARTIAL_RECOVERY, FAILED_VERIFICATION split), Non-Operational dual-confirmation approval, Recovery unable-to-collect decision queue (reschedule/close/escalate), Vehicle Unavailability Report review/manual-resume, and Component-Blocked Queue visibility. These are not thin admin wrappers around Ravi's actions - they are a second, PRD-substantial persona (PRD stories 20-41) hiding in the same module boundary. Recommend S2+ price ZM-oversight capabilities as a distinct capability cluster inside this module, not folded into Ravi's list.

capabilities.name: Ticket Detail full on-site context (device/vehicle/plant/transporter/SLA bucket/Failure Cycle history/expected components/hints/telemetry)
capabilities.why: SE arrives on-site blind, wrong diagnostic hypothesis, wasted plant visit

capabilities.name: Soft-state progress (VIEWED -> ON_SITE auto-geofence/manual -> TROUBLESHOOT_STARTED)
capabilities.why: ZM loses real-time SE Activity Status; dispatch and intra-day insertion confidence erodes

capabilities.name: Structured troubleshooting form with offline dedup (client_submission_id)
capabilities.why: plant connectivity is routinely poor; without dedup, reconnect produces duplicate submissions and corrupted root-cause analytics

capabilities.name: Component-unavailable flow (toggle raises Component Request, SLA pauses, Confirm Receipt resumes SLA + new submission)
capabilities.why: without it SE is stuck with no path to log a missing part; ticket silently ages with zero parts visibility

capabilities.name: Install lifecycle (SCHEDULED->ON_SITE->FITTED->ACTIVATED->CLOSED) with mandatory GPS/SIM serial capture
capabilities.why: new fitments share Ravi's day pool; missing serials break inventory records and GPS auto-verification can't track the new device_id

capabilities.name: Recovery collection lifecycle with mandatory serial-confirmation + condition notes, plus Unable-to-Collect reason-coded exit
capabilities.why: provider-owned asset recovery has no audit trail without it; SE has no legitimate way to end a blocked collection attempt

capabilities.name: Vehicle Unavailability Report (reason code, transporter contacted, expected-availability window) pausing primary SLA
capabilities.why: without it SE has no legitimate way to log a blocked stop; SLA unfairly ages against him for a vehicle he can't reach

capabilities.name: 409 Conflict screen with Shadow Use confirmation messaging
capabilities.why: without a clear message SE believes his physically-used components vanished, breeding distrust of van-stock accounting

capabilities.name: Verification outcome visibility on own submitted tickets (CLOSED / FAILED_VERIFICATION / PARTIAL_RECOVERY with ping count)
capabilities.why: no feedback loop otherwise; SE can't tell if a repair held, keeps calling ZM to check

capabilities.name: Technical Hints + raw telemetry section, always visible, no collapse
capabilities.why: advisory diagnostic signal cuts guesswork before physical inspection, especially for weak-signal/no-power cases

capabilities.name: QR / barcode scan entry shortcut into Ticket Detail, with disambiguation on multi-device match
capabilities.why: speeds stop start when labels are damaged; day still runs without it, just slower
